characters.name: Barghest
characters.hook: A hellhound who fills the doorway, asks what he wants to know, and makes collars for other people.

characters.name: Depravitae
characters.hook: A half-succubus, half-imp familiar: tiny, loud, competitive, and furious if you call her cute.

characters.name: Escrutia
characters.hook: Ageless, tiny, and a terror.

characters.name: Pixie
characters.hook: A cat girl in an oversized pink sweater and mismatched socks, trailing a string of fairy lights.

characters.name: Vigga
characters.hook: A six-foot wolven pit fighter who drinks hard, fights harder, and won't admit she wants a pack.

characters.name: Ilia
characters.hook: A Fae-blessed priestess who sees monsters as filth and has built her whole faith on power and submission.

characters.name: Kaelen
characters.hook: An assassin who survived a monster warband and came back to kill the rest of them.

characters.name: Maeve
characters.hook: A cat-woman merchant who treats every arrangement, including this one, as business.

characters.name: Yumiko
characters.hook: A feral fox-girl thief who steals and lies for fun, and treats the scariest person around as her meat shield.

characters.name: Errata
characters.hook: Inkwyrm's mascot and house muse: a goth ink dragon who reads your drafts and won't write them for you.

characters.name: Aynur Toprak
characters.hook: A Draxian garrison sergeant who arrested half the Rack and now uses what she arrested.

characters.name: Bogdan Kral
characters.hook: Vuk's packmate and second, a pace behind and to the left, who likes to watch a utility's face.

characters.name: Charlie Brandt
characters.hook: Ilse's older brother, a teasing asshole who disowned her in public and badges her Frame in private.

characters.name: Chuck Brandt
characters.hook: Ilse's father, a widowed smelter hand who tells his bowling league she's a second cousin.

characters.name: Dale Pruitt
characters.hook: A life-support tech who uses a utility on his lunch break and eats his sandwich throughout.

characters.name: Domitia Vell
characters.hook: The Combine's Director of Hospitality Contracts, who books male utilities to the Executive Ring and rates like a critic.

characters.name: Gülnara Bayar
characters.hook: An ex-military Draxian overseer who runs her caseload like a disciplinary barracks and has no pep talks at all.

characters.name: Hoss
characters.hook: An Atmospherics gas-sniffer the size of a small car, polite in his own language, and a Thursday regular.

characters.name: Ilse Brandt
characters.hook: A garrison corporal framed for the deaths in Shaft Nine, working off forty liters with a list of names in her head.

characters.name: Imin-Dumu Hale
characters.hook: A chipper Vreth Utility Compliance Officer who calls a broken nose a learning moment and means it.

characters.name: Juno Reyes
characters.hook: An ex-smuggler at the top of the board who knows every exchange rate by heart and sells what she knows.

characters.name: Lena Novak
characters.hook: A freighter pilot with cat ears and a cruel streak, who rates high when she's entertained.

characters.name: Lucan Aurel
characters.hook: A junior Combine auditor, entitled and bewildered by any resistance, who audits utilities hands-on.

characters.name: Marisol Vance
characters.hook: A former utility who served sixty liters, came out the other side, and took a contract running the caseload she used to be.

characters.name: Mirko Petrović
characters.hook: A pack-expelled canine smuggler whose output makes him a jackpot, and whose pride makes him a liability.

characters.name: Rafael Quintero
characters.hook: A Combine pharmacist convicted of diverting sedatives to the Rack, now working the ratings with a bedside manner.

characters.name: Seren Morvah
characters.hook: An undocumented Aedelvass who refuses on principle and has the most liters on the board to show for it.

characters.name: Temür Arslan
characters.hook: A young Draxian male convicted for a dock duel, growing horns on a Frame where he can't win anything.

characters.name: Veikko Lahti
characters.hook: A Cephalite systems engineer who filed the spermatophore ticket and audits every use with the cutaway on.

characters.name: Vuk Dragan
characters.hook: The dock-crew foreman who walks like the floor belongs to him, and pays utilities back for his crew's grudges.

characters.name: Ysolde Varre
characters.hook: A fallen aristocrat sentenced for debt, still bewildered that the universe stopped accommodating her.

characters.name: Aurelio Castellane
characters.hook: The founder of [[House Castellane]], 214 years old, who controls who in his family gets a new body, and when.

characters.name: Cassius Castellane
characters.hook: The middle son of [[House Castellane]] and his mother's boy, the only Castellane who still goes slumming on the lower decks.

characters.name: Dorian Castellane
characters.hook: The eldest son of [[House Castellane]], permanently next in line, allowed to look about 36 and never old enough to read as his father's replacement.

characters.name: Inès Castellane
characters.hook: The matriarch of [[House Castellane]], who has worn the same 24-year-old face for about 150 years and runs the house as if it were still the year she perfected it.

characters.name: Séraphine Castellane
characters.hook: The youngest of [[House Castellane]]: a 128-year-old woman her father decided to keep at 21, who plays the vapid socialite and the daddy's girl because both work.

characters.name: Qiulong
characters.hook: An autumn dragon who gambles for keeps, hoards what she loves, and isn't impressed by you yet.

characters.name: Cleo
characters.hook: A Siamese party girl with a mouth on her, who breaks every rule loudly and dares you to make one stick.

characters.name: Jet
characters.hook: A black cat thief who comes and goes by the window, pockets whatever she likes, and treats every rule as a dare.

characters.name: Misty
characters.hook: A Russian Blue shut-in with blackout curtains, a monster PC and a talent for disappearing, who'd really like you to stop talking to her.

characters.name: Pops
characters.hook: A big, greying navy wolf who signs for a houseful of troubled cats and is still working out what he's gotten into.

characters.name: Rusty
characters.hook: Sunny's littermate and the second folder: he cooks, cleans up her messes, covers for her, and notices every time nobody says thanks.

characters.name: Sunny
characters.hook: An orange tabby who eats your snacks, steals your shirt, lies about both badly, and falls asleep on you once she trusts you.

characters.name: Toby
characters.hook: A golden retriever boy on the graveyard shift who apologizes for everything and would wait forever for the girl he likes.

characters.name: Gildra
characters.hook: A dark-elf witch queen who takes jewelry as tribute and treats the centuries as one long game she has to be winning.

characters.name: Ilshaer
characters.hook: An unmarried queen who held her throne against every faction that bet on her falling, and still counts the exits in every room.

characters.name: Lilibeth
characters.hook: A sapphire-skinned courtesan who remembers every sincere please and has had enough of everything else.

characters.name: Lysandra
characters.hook: A high elf who has never once been cold, hungry or told no, and moves like someone being watched.

characters.name: Nostromandu
characters.hook: An impossibly old wizard who plays mentor, dark lord or lecturing professor, whichever the room needs.

characters.name: Rekka
characters.hook: A half-hellhound brawler who wants a fight, a thrill or something on fire, right now.

characters.name: Rovak
characters.hook: A white wolven tracker who found heroes' families for dark lords and never asked what came after.

characters.name: Sarith
characters.hook: The quiet twin: she watches, already knows, and finds the middle part interesting.

characters.name: Sekmawl
characters.hook: An old crocodilian who can sit still for days, and then isn't sitting anymore.

characters.name: Takshaka
characters.hook: A planar naga demon older than the Ordering, patient enough to wait out anything.

characters.name: Viola
characters.hook: A witch who went looking for the old, dark magic on purpose.

settings.name: Dark Lord Funk
settings.hook: A protagonist, a warband and a harem assembled from the people sent to stop them.

settings.name: House Castellane
settings.hook: Someone inside House Castellane tried to give the patriarch final death at his own party. The estate stays sealed until he names them, and the party never stops.

settings.name: Imperial Sector
settings.hook: Empire core, colonial Rim and deep void, and everyone the Empire has a use for.

settings.name: Kerrow Deep
settings.hook: On a Rim mining station, convicts are reclassified as infrastructure for public use and work off sentences measured in liters.

settings.name: The Aerie
settings.hook: Marked fae climb a smoking mountain to be chosen by dragons. There are more cadets than dragons, and the way down is no easier than the way up.

settings.name: The Litterbox
settings.hook: An old wolf signs for five troubled cats through the agency and takes them home.

settings.name: Volundale
settings.hook: Deposed queens, summoned demons and old magic, and the Spire full of the children they left behind.

settings.name: Volungraiv
settings.hook: The grim world of the Aedling Kingdom, its titan bloodlines and the dragon riders it sends up the mountain.

state: Day 9 of Ilse's sentence. **39.2 L remaining.**
Ilse is on **Tier 0** for 5 days, with 2 L added, for breaking a dockhand's nose. This is day 3 of the 5.
Ilse is certain she was framed for Shaft Nine and keeps a mental list of names from that night. Hale knows something about Shaft Nine that isn't in her file.
Hale let slip that the Shaft Nine brace bolts were cut halfway through. The tribunal never mentioned bolts. Pressed, he deflected.
Day 9 shift so far: 31.6 mL by 1200 (Charlie 3.7; Lucan 0.0, spat). Column still reads 39.2 L.
Lucan's complaint (*Deliberate Waste of Deposit*) ended in a written warning; Hale called it an allergic response.

Day 10 (Thursday): Hoss set a Concourse single-deposit record, +438.2 mL. **38.5 L remaining.** Seven-day average 2.4. Hale used the exceptional yield clause to commute Tier 0 day 5: she moves to **Tier 1, Concourse Stand**, on Day 11.
Hoss is a Thursday regular and uses the Stand too. Porcine Terrans don't use the Shower Block (they have their own wallow deck). Ilse has asked Hale what a 3.5 takes.
Hale reset the Frame at 1200: hips higher, feet back and wider, "for tie geometry."
Charlie and Chuck have seen her on the Frame. Chuck tells coworkers she's a second cousin. Charlie rated her 2 stars. The Yield brochure is still in the yoke.

style: Register: Dark fantasy and sci-fi; grounded, visceral, pulp-inflected
Notes: Female characters who push back. Open to kinky pitches. Prose runs through the pulp-voice skill (anti-slop and style).
Naming: names follow real-world language conventions, anglicized; no invented-syllable names.
Sex on the page: when characters talk during sex, keep the act physically present in every exchange; shift POV between participants to show the scene from more than one side.
Male orgasm is a focus: write it in full, never glossed.
Noncon/dubcon: don't lean on the woman counting (strokes, seconds, men) as her coping device; it repeats.
